//: The publish emit (design/08 §3.1, §3.2; design/13 decision 4). `isolatedDeclarations: true` — this package is ordinary functions and data, so it is free, it buys parallel emit, and it guarantees no inferred type leaks a deep internal path into the published `.d.ts`. `paths: {}` undoes the typecheck project's source mapping for `pg-prime`, so this emit reads the peer dependency's PUBLISHED declarations; `pnpm -r build` builds pg-prime first, because it is a workspace devDependency here.
